newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault head meets Jospin aide.
newsitem.headline: Dassault head meets Jospin aide.

text.p: Dassault Aviation chairman Serge Dassault met with a senior aide of new French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin on Thursday but would not comment on the talks.
The meeting between Dassault and Jean-Pierre Jouyet, deputy head of the prime minister's office, lasted 80 minutes.

The Socialist-led government must decide whether to proceed with the previous conservative government's plan to merge aircraft rivals Dassault and Aerospatiale and to sell off defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF.
The plan was aimed at meeting competition posed by mega-mergers in the United States.
Last month, French Defence Minister Alain Richard said there was room for just one plane maker in Europe and that he saw a combined Dassault-Aerospatiale as simply a component of such a company.
